name: SpotLit
description:
SpotLit is a two-sided marketplace platform that unlocks the hidden earning potential of privately-owned beautiful locations — by connecting them with individuals and event planners who need those spaces for photoshoots, celebrations, and functions.
The Core Problem It Solves:
Side
Problem
Location Owner
Has a beautiful space (farmhouse, terrace, garden, villa) but no system to monetize it
Event Seeker
Needs a unique, affordable, bookable location for shoots/events but can't find one easily
Goals:
Build a verified location listing platform where owners register, upload their space, set pricing and availability
Let event seekers browse, filter, and book locations by type, budget, city, and occasion
Handle payments, reviews, and dispute resolution inside the platform
Start with Tier 1 & Tier 2 Indian cities where pre-wedding shoots and event culture is booming
Long-term: expand to corporate shoots, brand campaigns, and OTT/film location rentals
